name: Franco Il Nero
source:
Franco Il Nero is the most daring and cunning criminal in the history of planet Sweetwater, that has 218 criminal charges and wanted dead or alive for a 500,000$ bounty. Vanished during the revolution 10 years ago, only to appear now.

Favoured Trademark Gun: [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruger_Blackhawk]Ruger Blackhawk[/url].
